_help: PLACEHOLDER BEDS (2026-11-24) - names, what each one fits and the slot count are NOT final, edit freely. home_slots = how many beds fit in the player's house at once. Each bed: 'accepts' = Pokémon display names it fits (variants match: 'Rattata' covers 019_Rattata_Alolan), 'accepts_templates' = any species that can spawn as one of these overworld templates (flyer, bug_tree, swinging_bug, skittish, burying, surfacing, static, fish_tank), 'accepts_any' = true fits everything, 'water' = true for a tank (its Pokémon swims there and does not wander the house), 'description' = shop text for later. A bed holds ONE Pokémon. Read by Scripts/Objects_And_Classes/Overworld_Pokemon/Pokemon_Home.gd. DEL menu: 'Give one of each bed' / 'Empty the house'.

Straw Basket.description: A cosy basket for small Pokémon.

Leafy Nest.description: A bed of soft leaves bug Pokémon love to curl up in.

Perch.description: A sturdy perch for bird Pokémon to roost on.

Home Fish Tank.description: A tank for the house, so a fish you befriend has somewhere to sleep.
